chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Do not perform salat (prayer) behind one who seeks payment for the adhan and the salat (prayer) with the people, and his testimony is not accepted.

key_terms.خَلْفَ: behind, meaning in following an Imam in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.شَهَادَتُهُ: his testimony in a legal or judicial context

ai.seo_question: Can you pray behind someone who takes payment for the adhan and leading salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who seeks wages for the adhan and for leading the people in salat (prayer). It states that one should not pray behind such a person and that his legal testimony is not accepted, indicating a deficiency affecting both communal worship and judicial credibility.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3290 - And Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:
"Do not pray behind one who seeks payment for the call to prayer and leading people in prayer, and his testimony is not accepted."
